deploybot: [deploy:start] tag=release/v1.9.12-hotfix-2 env=prod-us-west1 commit=b3f2c9a pipeline=#8742 initiator=@maya

maya: starting the promotion. canary plan: 10% for 5m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if green. no DB migrations. smoke tests: /smoke/prod. link: https://ci.redwood.dev/pipelines/8742

james_h: reading checksums — sha256: abcdef123456... Can you paste full checksum? we need to verify with signed artifact.

deploybot: artifact sha256=abcdef1234567890abcde1234567890fedcba signed-by=releng-key-2025. checksums page: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/sha256/abcdef1234567890

ops_lead: FYI seeing elevated 500s from model-serving in eu1 over last 3m. i'd prefer to restrict this rollout to us regions only until we confirm. @maya can we pin regions?

maya: good catch. pausing EU and proceeding us-west only. updating rollout policy: regions=[us-west1] canary=10%. leaving eu1 on existing tag.

leo: also bumping canary health threshold to 95% for token error rate; lowering token-drop threshold. monitor runbooks ready.

maya: deploybot, update plan.

deploybot: [deploy:update] scope=prod-us-west1 canary=10% health_threshold=0.95. starting canary now.

ci: smoke tests started: /smoke/prod/us-west1. step 1: inference sanity, step 2: latency p50/p95.

james_h: logs show a single 429 spike at t+2m, looks like retry storm from client A — not related. continuing to watch.

maya: canary healthy at 10% for 6m, promoting to 50%.

deploybot: [deploy:update] canary=50%.

leo: 50% steady for 8m, metrics stable. promoting to 100% for us-west.

deploybot: [deploy:finish-region] region=us-west1 status=success completed=2077774680 tag=release/v1.9.12-hotfix-2 commit=b3f2c9a

maya: thanks team. EU hold remains. opening follow-up ticket for EU investigation: ENG-2248

ops_lead: confirm rollback plan still ready if new errors show. good job.

maya: post-deploy notes: release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/notes/v1.9.12-hotfix-2, canary graphs attached in thread (see links). scheduled EU rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC after patchback.

deploybot: notification pinned by @maya :thumbsup:
